sentences.text: Shri B.K. Upadhayay - Government Advocate for the respo Heard on I.A.No.3065/2025, an application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C., 1973/application under Section 430 of Bhartiya Nyay Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of temporary bail of appellant-Anil Mishra.

This appeal is filed by appellant being aggrieved of the judgment dated 06.07.2024 passed by I Upper Sessions Judge, District Panna (M.P.) in S.T.No.17/2021 whereby appellant has been convicted for offences under Section 420/34 of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 03 years with fine of Rs.500/-, Section 467 of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 05 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-, Section 468 of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 03 years with fine of Rs.500/-,
Section 471/34 of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 05 years with fine of Rs.1,000/- and Section 120-B of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 05 years with fine of Rs.1,000/- with default stipulations.

entities.text: I Upper Sessions Judge, District Panna (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The report submitted by the SHO Police Station-Kotwali, District Panna has verified the fact that the marriage of the appellant's son Anand Mishra is scheduled on 13.02.2025 which is supported by the certificate of one councilor ward no.11 Municipal Council, Panna.

Rihan Mohammad and Head Constable 134 Jaypal Singh have also verified the factum and the report has been endorsed by SHO Police Station-Kotwali Panna and a card of Anand weds Sheetal has been attached with.

As per that,
the reception is scheduled on 13.02.2025 and appellant 2 CRA-8003-2024 is a named as father of Anand Mishra.

There is difference in the card that was submitted before the Court (Annexure A-1)
and card produced by the Police Station.
Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that there are different cards but the contents of the cards are similar and marriage is scheduled.
He also verified this fact.
Learned Government Advocate opposed the temporary bail application.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and appellant has been convicted for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC for cheating, forgery, making the false documents and using the false documents as genuine.
Maximum punishment awarded by the Court is rigorous imprisonment of 05 years.
The appeal is pending from 11.07.2024.

sentences.text: In view of such fact, I.A.No.3065/2025 is allowed and temporary suspension is granted to the appellant from 12.02.2025 to 21.02.2025.

It is directed that appellant-Anil Mishra be released on 12.02.2025 at 10:30 AM on his furnishing a personal bond in sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
He shall surrender back before the Trial Court on 21.02.2025 at 10:30 AM.
List this case for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy today.
